All admin screens

The site

  • LifecycleWhat state guests see, what the calendar suggests, and previewing another state.
  • Feature flagsBoth halves of every gate, and the two legal switches that stay shut.
  • ContentRecords with provenance, freshness and verification.
  • Events & RSVP windowEvents, meal options, notices, and when RSVP opens.
  • SitemapEvery endpoint the app serves, and what each one should answer.

Guests

  • GuestsPeople, households they belong to, identity resets.
  • HouseholdsHousehold records and mailing addresses.
  • InvitationsIssue, rotate and revoke invitation links.
  • RSVPsWho has replied, overrides and exports.
  • SeatingTables, assignments and publishing the chart.

The weekend

  • Travel & stayHotels, links and the room block.
  • TransportBenefit entitlements and voucher codes.
  • GiftsRegistry and gift links.
  • ReservationsVenues guests can book through.

Media & AI

  • MediaModeration queue, imports and duplicates.
  • Media AICaptions, indexing and what the model may touch.
  • ConciergeAnswer traces, grounding failures, security alerts.

Operations

  • Audit trailEvery action anyone took, searchable, redacted.
  • JobsQueue depth, failures and retries.
  • MetricsWhat this deployment recorded, and whether it is recording.
  • ProvidersWhich adapter each integration resolved to, and what it can do.

Internal routes
URLExampleAudienceMethodPurposeExpected
/t/[theme]/t/botanical-decopublicGETThe statically rendered theme tree the proxy rewrites a clean public URL onto. Not a page in the guest’s sense.200 for a known theme. An unknown theme is 404. Visitors normally arrive via the clean URL (/), which the proxy rewrites here.
/t/[theme]/preview/[token]/t/botanical-deco/preview/RSVP_OPENpublicGETHome with an admin lifecycle preview token. The proxy rewrites /?preview=… here.200 for any visitor. The preview changes what an administrator sees; everyone else sees the published lifecycle.

API and export routes

API and export routes
URLExampleAudienceMethodPurposeExpected
/api/health/api/healthapiGETLiveness. Public body is ok, db and time. Inventory (driver, providers, lifecycle) is for an admin or the HEALTH_TOKEN bearer.200 when the database is up, 503 when it is not. No guest data.
/api/session/api/sessionapiGETWhether this browser is signed in, for the account menu. Not a gate.200. Anonymous: signedIn false. A view-role preview names the role and nothing about a real guest.
/api/capabilities/[name]/api/capabilities/admin_list_view_rolesapiGETThe capability door does not answer GET.405 Allow: POST. POST runs one capability. The crawler never POSTs except admin_set_view_role on the test server, to mint a preview.
/api/capabilities/[name]/api/capabilities/admin_list_view_rolesapiPOSTThe only HTTP door into the capability pipeline (CSRF, rate limit, audit).200 with { ok: true } when the principal may run it. 401 signed out, 403 without the entitlement, 405 is not used for POST.
/api/ai/chat/api/ai/chatapiGETThe concierge stream is POST only.405 Allow: POST.
/api/ai/chat/api/ai/chatapiPOSTAsk the concierge. Answers are grounded in published pages. No hosted model is called.200 NDJSON when the body is JSON from this origin. 403 on a form-encoded or cross-origin POST.
/api/auth/[...all]/api/auth/get-sessionapiGETBetter Auth session read and passkey ceremony. OTP and claim are capabilities, not this route.Better Auth’s own status. A cross-origin mutation is 403 before the library runs.
/api/auth/[...all]/api/auth/sign-outapiPOSTBetter Auth mutations (sign-out, passkey). Same-origin only.403 when Origin is not this site. Otherwise Better Auth’s response. The crawler does not call it.
/api/webmcp/manifest/api/webmcp/manifestapiGETWebMCP tools the current principal may see.200 JSON manifest. POST is 405.
/api/webmcp/manifest/api/webmcp/manifestapiPOSTManifest is read-only.405 Allow: GET.
/api/webmcp/invoke/[name]/api/webmcp/invoke/exampleapiGETWebMCP invoke is POST only.405 Allow: POST.
/api/webmcp/invoke/[name]/api/webmcp/invoke/exampleapiPOSTRun one WebMCP tool as the current principal.The tool’s own status. Unknown name is refused. The crawler does not call it.
/api/uploads/[action]/api/uploads/createapiGETUpload aliases of media capabilities. GET is refused.405 Allow: POST. POST create, resume, complete or abort. Any other action is 404.
/api/uploads/[action]/api/uploads/createapiPOSTStart, resume, finish or abort an upload through the capability pipeline.Same rules as /api/capabilities. The crawler does not upload.
/api/jobs/run/api/jobs/runapiGETCron: run a bounded batch of due jobs. GET and POST are the same handler.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. The handler does not run jobs when it refuses. The crawler does not call it.
/api/jobs/run/api/jobs/runapiPOSTCron: same handler as GET.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. With the bearer, runs due jobs. Never called by the crawler.
/api/media-ai/jobs/run/api/media-ai/jobs/runapiGETCron alias that keeps the media index scan queued and runs a bounded batch.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. Does not run when it refuses.
/api/media-ai/jobs/run/api/media-ai/jobs/runapiPOSTCron alias, same handler as GET.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. Never called by the crawler.
/api/uploads/jobs/run/api/uploads/jobs/runapiGETCron alias that keeps a media sweep queued and runs a bounded batch.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. Does not run when it refuses.
/api/uploads/jobs/run/api/uploads/jobs/runapiPOSTCron alias, same handler as GET.401 without the CRON_SECRET bearer. Never called by the crawler.
/api/webhooks/resend/api/webhooks/resendapiGETResend inbound mail is POST only.405 Allow: POST.
/api/webhooks/resend/api/webhooks/resendapiPOSTSigned Resend inbound events. Forwards mail for the wedding address to the planner.401 or 400 without a valid Svix signature. The crawler does not post a body.
/travel/webhooks/duffel/travel/webhooks/duffelapiGETDuffel booking events are POST only.405 Allow: POST.
/travel/webhooks/duffel/travel/webhooks/duffelapiPOSTSigned Duffel booking webhook. Not a guest page.404 when no webhook is configured, 401 when the signature is missing. The crawler does not post a body.
/api/dev/inbox/api/dev/inboxapiGETDevelopment inbox of OTP mail captured by the mock mailer.404 when the dev gate is closed (production, and CI without the bearer). Otherwise 200 and the captured messages. The crawler does not call DELETE, which clears the inbox.
/api/dev/inbox/api/dev/inboxapiDELETEClears the development inbox.404 when the dev gate is closed. Otherwise 200 and the inbox is empty. Never called by the crawler.
/api/dev/identity/api/dev/identityapiPOSTDevelopment only: seeds a fresh fixture identity set and returns its tokens.404 when the dev gate is closed. Otherwise 200 with fixture ids. Creates rows. Never called by the crawler.
/api/dev/storage/[...key]/api/dev/storage/exampleapiGETLocal-fs stand-in for signed upload bytes. Not production storage.404 in production. Outside production, a signed query reads an object; an unsigned request is refused.
/api/dev/storage/[...key]/api/dev/storage/exampleapiHEADLocal-fs object metadata.404 in production. Same signature rule as GET.
/api/dev/storage/[...key]/api/dev/storage/exampleapiPUTLocal-fs write of one upload part.404 in production. A signed PUT writes bytes. Never called by the crawler.
/admin/guests/export/admin/guests/exportadminGETCSV of guests for an administrator with guest ops.401 signed out. 200 text/csv for an administrator who may export. Read-only.
/admin/rsvp/export/admin/rsvp/exportadminGETCSV of RSVPs for an administrator with guest ops.401 signed out. 200 text/csv for an administrator who may export. Read-only.
/sitemap.xml/sitemap.xmlpublicGETPublic URL list for search engines. Audience public only; see the note in docs/sitemap.md.200 application/xml. No admin, guest or gate path.
